summary: FWC's own pages no longer describe any camping at Escribano Point: the WMA's Things to Do and Planning pages list hunting, fishing, wildlife viewing, hiking and paddling only, its 2026-27 regulations summary says 'Camping: Prohibited.', and the WebReserv booking link answers 'Page Not Found'. Nothing written; flagged for a human (likely closed for good).
flags: Likely permanent closure of camping: FWC's Escribano Point WMA Regulations Summary for July 01, 2026 - June 30, 2027 (https://app.myfwc.com/hgm/hgmsearch/wmad?brochureTitle=Escribano%20Point, read 2026-10-21 in a browser) says 'Camping: Prohibited.' The WMA's pages (https://myfwc.com/recreation/lead/escribano-point/things-to-do/) list no camping, the stored WebReserv link (https://www.webreserv.com/showproduct.do?businessid=escribanopointwildlifemanagementareafl&ptid=54655) returns 'Page Not Found ... unable to locate the specified business', and The Dyrt lists 'Escribano Point WMA Bayside Campground - CLOSED' (aggregator, corroboration only). The note's 'Free FWC permit/reservation required (WebReserv or phone)' and the derived booking.reservable / $0 fees rest on a channel that no longer exists. A phone check with FWC's Northwest Region (the stored 850-265-3676) would settle it; if closed, the entry should leave the database.
Dead website: the second website line (WebReserv) is dead as above; the FWC WMA page itself is live but says nothing about camping.
